first_love_costume.trousers: plain black slacks (dress trousers: straight leg, belt loops, a slight crease), not jeans (Jade 2026-11-26: "normal black slacks"; CAST FL_SLACKS)
first_love_costume.sandals: Birkenstock-type cork sandals made by Naot (Jade); modelled as plain cork-soled sandals with two straps

jade_costume.jacket: thin black zip-front jacket, worn unzipped and nearly closed over the tee (ASSUMED zip, open); a SMALL NASA meatball insignia (disc about 8 cm) on its LEFT chest, EXACTLY the decal layout/assets/art/logos/nasa_meatball.png (pass it as a reference): the real 1959 meatball, blue disc, white stars, white orbit ring, red chevron and its small white NASA lettering, the same in every shot (2026-11-26, Jade: one version of the logo; r4 decision art_meatball: WITH the white lettering, confirmed)
jade_costume.tee: fitted black t-shirt with an SR-71 Blackbird print: planform from above, angled down and to the left so it reads like a triangle, dark grey on black, subtle (Jade). Only a sliver shows between the jacket fronts

jade_costume.feet: at the party (indoors, the deck): socks, no shoes (Jade); colour plain mid-grey ASSUMED
jade_costume.before_party: same outfit before the party; OUTDOORS in the yard (V3a, V3b) SNEAKERS, not socks (Jade 2026-11-27): ASSUMED plain black canvas low-tops, white rubber soles and toe bumper; in the kitchen (V3b_prep) socks. NO belt (Jade): the jacket hangs over the waistband
